subject: Taxes
title: Social Norms and Tax Honesty
description: A short lesson to help you apply Social Norms and Tax Honesty.

hook.text: A Minnesota study found telling taxpayers '93% of neighbors pay on time' boosted compliance more than threats.

buildup.text: Humans are social animals. We look to others' behavior to decide our own.

twist.text: But the reverse also works. Telling people that 'lots of people cheat on taxes' increases cheating. Norms cut both ways.

climax.text: Every news story about widespread tax evasion may actually boost evasion by normalizing it. Messaging matters deeply.

punchline.text: '93% pay on time' beats 'we'll fine you.' Social norms drive tax behavior.

quiz.question: What increased tax compliance more in the Minnesota experiment?
options: Telling taxpayers most of their neighbors pay on time
Offering a reward for early filing
